author: JR Ferrer-Paris
title: Data exploration and validation

The purpose of this script is to import and validate the cross-referencing information consolidated in membership tables.

This scripts identifies duplicates and potential problems before further steps of analysis and synthesis.

 This script is intended for interactive use and data exploration.

Source classification and spatial data (units):
 > DPIRD 006 (vegetation associations)
Target classification (units):
 > IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (ecosystem functional groups)

## Lookup table for source classification

```{r}
lut_file <- here::here(
    gisdata_dir,
    "preeuropeanvegetationlutsummary-may2012.xlsx"
)

LUT <- read_xlsx(lut_file) |>
    mutate(
        `System-Association Code` = as.character(round(
            `System-Association Code`,
            2
        )),
        eligible = TRUE
    )

DPIRD_LUT <- lookup_tbl(
    LUT,
    id = "System-Association Code",
    name = "Original Association Description",
    eligible = "eligible"
)
```

Lookup table target classification, based on the IUCN GET vocabulary, and adding the T5.6 EFG (proposed):
```{r}
#| label: Lookup table target
IUCN_GET <- bind_rows(
    IUCN_GET_LUT,
    {
        tibble(efg_id = "T5.6", eligible = TRUE)
    }
) |>
    lookup_tbl("efg_id", "efg_name")
```

```{r}
DPIRD_LUT |>
    summarise(
        rows = n(),
        sa_code = n_distinct(`System-Association Code`),
        map_units = n_distinct(`Map Unit ID`),
        veg_type = n_distinct(`Vegetation Type No`),
        .by = c(`Map Unit Type`)
    )
```

```{r}
## Step 4: read additional data for outputs

### 4a. Read GIS data

DPIRD_xy <- read_sf(here::here(
    gisdata_dir,
    "Pre_European_Vegetation_DPIRD_006_WA_GDA2020_Public.gpkg"
)) |>
    mutate(sa_code = as.character(round(sa_code, 1)))
```

```{r}
### Membership tables

memb_data <- foreach(
    j = dir(xref_dir, pattern = ".csv"),
    .combine = bind_rows
) %do% {
    metadata <- read_csv(
        here::here(xref_dir, j),
        col_names = c("name", "value"),
        n_max = 12,
        show_col_types = F
    )[, 1:2]
    data <- read_csv(here::here(xref_dir, j), skip = 13, show_col_types = F)
    cat(sprintf(
        "Read %s, interpreter %s\n%s\n",
        j,
        metadata[1, 2],
        metadata[12, 2]
    ))

    if ("EFG_1" %in% colnames(data)) {
        guess_round <- str_extract(j, "(?<=V)[0-9]")
        data_with_id <- data |> mutate(ID = row_number(), .by = `System-Association Code`)
        cat(sprintf("Assigning this to round %s\n", guess_round))

        pivot_wide_membership_table(
            xref = data_with_id,
            original_names = c("System-Association Code", "ID"),
            target_names = sprintf("EFG_%s", 1:4),
            membership_values = sprintf("memb_%s", 1:4),
            expert_name = metadata[[1, 2]],
            round = as.numeric(guess_round)
        )
    }
}
```

```{r}
memb_data |>
    filter(!is.na(memb), memb > 0) |>
    group_by(expert, round) |>
    summarise(
        `source ids` = n_distinct(`System-Association Code`),
        `target ids` = n_distinct(EFG),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
```

## Step 2: data validation

```{r}
DPIRD_memb <- memb_data |>
    filter(!is.na(memb), memb > 0) |>
    mutate(
        `System-Association Code` = as.character(round(
            `System-Association Code`,
            2
        ))
    ) |>
    membership_tbl(
        source_id = "System-Association Code",
        target_id = "EFG",
        membership = "memb",
        interpreter = "expert",
        round = "round"
    )
```

```{r}
check_membership(DPIRD_memb, source = DPIRD_LUT, target = IUCN_GET)
```

```{r}
DPIRD_memb |>
    filter(!EFG %in% IUCN_GET$efg_id) |>
    summarise(
        n_distinct(`System-Association Code`),
        .by = c(expert, round, EFG)
    )
```

```{r}
DPIRD_clean <- clean_membership(
    DPIRD_memb,
    source = DPIRD_LUT,
    target = IUCN_GET,
    action = "check"
)
```


```{r}
DPIRD_clean <- DPIRD_clean |> filter(!grepl("duplicated record", flag))
DPIRD_clean |> summarise(sum(grepl("duplicated", flag)), .by = ID)

DPIRD_clean |>
    filter(ID == 1 & grepl("duplicated", flag)) |>
    arrange(`System-Association Code`, ID, expert, round)
```

```{r}
DPIRD_clean |>
    mutate(dups = grepl("duplicated assignment", flag)) |>
    summarise(
        source_units = n_distinct(`System-Association Code`),
        .by = c(expert, round, dups)
    )
```

```{r}
DPIRD_clean |>
    mutate(dups = grepl("duplicated assignment", flag)) |>
    filter(dups, round == 3)
```

```{r}
DPIRD_LUT |>
    filter(`System-Association Code` %in% "3.3") |>
    glimpse()
DPIRD_xy |>
    filter(sa_code %in% "3.3") |>
    mapview()
DPIRD_memb |>
    filter(`System-Association Code` == "3.3") |>
    summarise(sum(memb), n(), .by = c(expert, round, EFG))
```


```{r}

sid <- 358

DPIRD_LUT |>
    filter(`System-Association Code` %in% sid) |>
    glimpse()
DPIRD_xy |>
    filter(sa_code %in% sid) |>
    mapview()
DPIRD_memb |>
    filter(`System-Association Code` == sid) |>
    summarise(sum(memb), mean(memb), n(), .by = c(expert, round, EFG))
DPIRD_memb |>
    filter(`System-Association Code` == sid, round == 3)
```
